lemmas.primary_translation: accept something one is actually against in order to achieve something else

definitions.text: godta noe som en egentlig er imot for å oppnå noe annet
definitions.translation: to accept something that one is actually against in order to achieve something else (lit. swallow/devour camels)

examples.no: begge partene måtte svelge noen kameler
examples.en: both parties had to accept some things they were actually opposed to

examples.no: partiet sluker kameler for å komme i regjering
examples.en: the party accepts things it is actually opposed to in order to get into government
